apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: grafana-mcp
  namespace: robusta
  labels:
    app: grafana-mcp
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: grafana-mcp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: grafana-mcp
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: grafana-mcp
        image: grafana/mcp-grafana:latest
        args:
        - "-t"

        - "--address"
        - "0.0.0.0:8000"
        - "--endpoint-path"

        - "--allowed-hosts"
        - "*"
        - "--disable-write"
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8000
          name: http
        env:
        - name: GRAFANA_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: grafana-mcp-secrets
              key: url
        - name: GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: grafana-mcp-secrets
              key: token
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8000
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
---
apiVersion: v1

metadata:
  name: grafana-mcp
  namespace: robusta
spec:
  selector:
    app: grafana-mcp
  ports:
  - name: http
